subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, bootstrap-aware prompts, startup context, and model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while related issues also ask to restore model turns or customize prompt text, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define one reset-start policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy covering ack-only, startup/model turn, prompt customization, optional model override, and suppression across schema, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep ack-only default with opt-in greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped low-cost static reset response and expose an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave reset prompt or startup-turn customization to related discussions until maintainers sponsor the contract.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy covering ack-only, startup/model turn, prompt customization, optional model override, and suppression across schema, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans reset acknowledgement behavior, config compatibility, Gateway reset behavior, and prior reset-contract review history tied to steipete.
